logging.dispatch-service.config:
Dispatch service application logging configuration. Project: dispatch-service. Source: Permanently revised approved dispatch-service logging configuration (v2). This is the current approved contract (v2).

```json
{
  "project": "dispatch-service",
  "logging": {
    "level": "error",
    "format": "text",
    "retention_days": 14,
    "sample_rate": 0.1,
    "redact_user_ids": true
  }
}
```

Fields and types: level (string "error"), format (string "text"), retention_days (integer 14), sample_rate (float 0.1), redact_user_ids (boolean true). Units in field names: retention_days is in days. Change from v1: sample_rate revised from 0.5 to 0.1.
